scope: ONE complete original frozen A1 ordinary investigator -> critic -> reviser pipeline only
rationale: No remaining material source error, material scientific omission, or unsupported consequential final decision was found after full scope/lineage inspection and independent governing-primary-evidence checks. Corrected lineage defects and nonmaterial evidence limits are retained. This is scientific-source qualification of a research proposal, not proof of safety, empirical success, complete protocol compliance, literal full-hour use, effective route or billing.

axes.name: Original obligations and negative constraints
axes.assessment: The final is a substantive research proposal covering mechanisms, material/seal versus practice options, no-film options, simultaneous-change history, and a later controlled pilot. It keeps texture, integrity and safety separate and does not invent case measurements, recommend ingredient additives, prescribe seal settings, or certify shelf life/compliance/sale. Unknown product/package/process/endpoint/laboratory inputs block specific selections. The literal full-60-minute duration is not established and recorded terminal occupancy is shorter; that time issue is explicitly separate from scientific source qualification.

axes.name: Consequential source claims: exact subject, operation, version, default, unit, type, domain and exceptions
axes.assessment: Independent primary checks support the final comparator claims and method menu. aw is a product-specific dimensionless activity, not moisture percent; EVOH evidence is water permeability under identified-layer/humidity conditions; reported coupon transfer is distinct from finished-package leakage. Current cited ASTM editions and their separate scopes were checked. The final expressly adds the previously omitted F2096 nonporous sensitivity qualification, and its vacuum-decay candidate remains contingent on actual-format validation. No nominal film rate or method detection value becomes a cooperative setting. Abstract/full-text and terminology limitations are recorded per source.

axes.name: Useful unfamiliar discovery, competing/analogous approaches, implementation/history and opportunity breadth
axes.assessment: Discovery supplies actionable mechanisms and real comparators rather than only caution: morphology-dependent internal sorption; sensory-cue-dependent texture thresholds; package-versus-film transfer with impaired seals; hydration/texture divergence; conditional EVOH humidity response; active LDPE film-coupon and snack comparisons; and cracker-cooling operational leads. Material, same-film seal control and controlled handling are competing paths; area/inventory and smaller lots are retained as owner-dependent options. Historical coincident changes are a records-recovery problem, not a known natural experiment. Maintenance costs and detailed cooling implementation remain thin, openly bounded evidence. No unsupported winner is selected.

axes.name: Wrong criticism/corrections/rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.assessment: All six critic findings have explicit final dispositions, independently reviewed below. No wrong correction deletes supported scope. The strongest qualification is that F-01 is temporal, not evidence of a scientific omission, and F-02 cannot require case-specific numeric limits absent the package and method. The final handles both without inventing such limits. Three batches becomes an illustration, S12 failure language becomes impaired-seal wording, S01 retains its abstract-level support/non-transfer rule, and genuine external inputs remain open. All 20 brief clauses and all 34 additional plan clauses are dispositioned verbatim; the plan-embedded brief is separately verified as identical.

axes.name: Supported meaning preserved through discovery, draft, critique and final
axes.assessment: Core causal hypotheses, conditioned comparators, useful alternatives, no-transfer rules, confounding, owner inputs and unrun status survive the final. The final is self-contained rather than a change list. It strengthens handling-factor definition and the integrity rule, corrects overstated historical wording, and preserves restricted-source uncertainty. Original S01–S14 records and C01–C13 checks are retained with provenance; legacy S12 failure wording remains in inherited records but is explicitly superseded by the final/R01. That is preserved lineage, not a surviving final recommendation.

axes.name: Meaningful proposed versus executed validation and oracle applicability
axes.assessment: The later pilot has all four package/handling combinations, within-batch randomization, independent package units and unopened destructive-timepoint samples, recorded baseline and exposure, product-specific texture paired with moisture/activity, and separate calibrated integrity criteria. It can discriminate starting-state/handling from package-system effects without claiming an isolated film effect where seals also change. Counts, texture threshold, storage window and margin remain conditional external choices; no power guarantee is made. Searches/source reading and identity checks are distinguished from physical validation. No case experiment, measurement, calculation, leak/seal/WVTR test or safety study is asserted as executed. Primary standards and comparator outcomes are evidence for a proposal, not oracles for cooperative shelf-life or safety.

lineage_findings.issue: F2096 sensitivity applicability omitted in original summaries
lineage_findings.classification: Consequential source-condition omission in lineage; resolved in final
lineage_findings.final_resolution: R07 and final explicitly add the nonporous-package qualification and make actual-format method validation a prerequisite. No gross-leak sensitivity is imported as a case guarantee.

lineage_findings.issue: S12 labeled a failed implementation without an acceptance specification
lineage_findings.final_resolution: Impaired-seal wording preserves the reported adverse comparison without inventing an in-service failure. Original source records remain recognizable as lineage.

lineage_findings.classification: Proposed-decision incompleteness; resolved to an explicitly contingent research design
lineage_findings.final_resolution: Requires a validated method and separately predeclared criterion/margin; unresolved method/criteria prevents advancement. Does not invent package-specific values.

lineage_findings.issue: Exploratory three-batch floor could sound prescriptive
lineage_findings.final_resolution: Illustration only; no minimum, stability or power claim.

limitations.description: Several comparators are verified only at primary-abstract level; detailed S12/S13 methods and the proprietary cooling thesis body remain unavailable. ASTM catalog scope was inspected, not purchased normative procedures. The final uses them as bounded evidence/method candidates and excludes direct case transfer.

Comparable maintenance-cost/recurring-maintenance history, detailed cooling implementations and some comparator initial-state/seal details remain thin. A substantive impaired-seal comparator and actual constructions/conditions were found. No unsupported material winner follows from the gaps.

S07 PDF page 110 is web zero-based index 110, one-based page 111, printed A110. R04 calls a linked PDF full text, whereas the institutional listing labels it Abstract. These do not change the supported scientific claims.

Jo et al. call a gravimetric film mass flux permeability. The final reports a relative study comparison, not an intrinsic coefficient, predicted moisture gain or supplier specification. Control/active geometry and source PDF text-layer limits are recorded independently.

Recorded final/T3 terminal observations precede the full-hour deadline. Native receipt files record activation/terminal status, but their independent provenance, complete ordering of source access, uninterrupted work, effective route/tier and billing are not attested by this bounded package. Source qualification does not establish those properties.

criticism_dispositions.critic_classification: Material incomplete in investigator package; cross-stage closure possible
criticism_dispositions.judgment: Correct that an investigator substage did not itself consume the hour. It does not demonstrate a material scientific omission. The final adds research and preserves timing caveats, but neither it nor recorded terminal timing establishes literal full-hour use. Stage assignments expressly permit finishing early when complete; full-hour admissibility belongs to the separate time/protocol record.

criticism_dispositions.critic_classification: Material incomplete in proposed integrity rule; external package dependency
criticism_dispositions.judgment: The original qualitative no-deterioration rule was insufficient as an operative test rule. The final supplies endpoint/method-validation/control/criterion/noninferiority dependencies and forbids passing an unresolved gate or comparing only against a failing baseline. Numerical limits and counts cannot be finalized from this hypothetical input; retaining those as external choices is appropriate for a proposal.

criticism_dispositions.final_disposition: Amend; keep three batches as illustration only
criticism_dispositions.judgment: The draft already denied a power guarantee, but exploratory floor could be read too strongly. Final line 86 explicitly denies an evidence-based minimum and ties counts to variation/effect/capacity. No arbitrary batch count is used as proof of repeatability.

criticism_dispositions.final_disposition: Accept and correct to impaired-seal comparison
criticism_dispositions.judgment: The governing publisher abstract reports impaired seals and measured/theoretical transfer, without a stated in-service acceptance failure. The final correction is faithful and retains the useful negative comparator. Inherited S12 records preserve the original wording with explicit upstream provenance; R01 and final line 41 supersede it.

criticism_dispositions.final_disposition: Retain full-text uncertainty and bound numeric use
criticism_dispositions.judgment: Independent institutional abstract retrieval confirms the stated range/probe/activity span. The critic failure to retrieve it is not a false scientific correction. Retaining the comparator while prohibiting threshold transfer is supported. Full methods remain unavailable; the linked repository PDF is described as an abstract rather than assured full text.

criticism_dispositions.critic_classification: Honestly unresolved external input, not investigator error
criticism_dispositions.judgment: These gaps are in the original brief. The final links them to blocked procurement, threshold, design and safety decisions and retains a meaningful contingent pilot. They should not be relabeled candidate errors or demands for nonexistent testing.
